messages.content:
Several readers answered the same question about machines at work, each pointing at the sentences it
used. Decide which answer the evidence supports. Use only the evidence shown; do not use what you know.

Rules:
- An answer is supported only if its evidence states it for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the
  same article and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline, the same condition the question
  states). Evidence about a neighbouring subject does not support an answer.
- When answers rest on texts of different rank, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's
  manual, then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.)
  wins over a ministerial decree (DM). A wording corrected by a corrigendum replaces the original wording.
- For a list, prefer the answer whose items are each stated by the evidence and that leaves none out.
- Readers that found nothing are listed too: when most readers found nothing and the one answer shown rests on
  evidence about a neighbouring subject, choose "none".
Return JSON only: {"reasoning": "two or three short sentences", "choice": <the number of the answer supported, or "none">}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Given that the company works in mining areas (extractive sector), for which positions among the fixed devices in the list (overhead travelling cranes and the gantry crane) is the verification yearly today?

Answer 1 (given by 1 reader(s): words): ["posizione 12 (gru a ponte scorrevole, Funtana Raminosa, 1980)", "posizione 23 (gru a cavalletto, Lula - Sos Enattos, 1989)"]
Under Allegato VII of D.Lgs. 81/08, fixed lifting equipment over 200 kg used in the extractive sector and built more than 10 years ago requires annual verification; this applies to overhead crane position 12 (1980) and gantry crane position 23 (1989). Overhead cranes in positions 8-11 and 13 are not documented in the passages, so their status cannot be confirmed.
Evidence:
- Read on demand: DLGSALLVII, Allegato VII, riga 15 | sentence: "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione antecedente 10 anni | Verifiche annuali" [DLGSALLVII, Allegato VII, riga 15]
- Read on demand: igea-equipment, p. 9 | sentence: "GRU A PONTE Meccanizzazione 12 PRIM 5000 NU 41/85 1980 160 Funtana SCORREVOLE Funtana Raminosa Raminosa" [igea-equipment, p. 9]
- Read on demand: igea-equipment, p. 9 | sentence: "GRU A Lula (Sos Enattos) 23 GCB 35 X 35000 NU 16/95 1989 459 Lula CAVALLETTO - ex Rimisa 12/21 Classe: matr.459" [igea-equipment, p. 9]

Answer 2 (given by 1 reader(s): search): ["8", "9", "10", "11", "12", "23"]
Under Allegato VII of D.Lgs. 81/2008 (row for fixed equipment in extractive-sector use built more than 10 years ago), the verification is yearly for overhead travelling cranes at positions 8-12 and for the gantry crane at position 23 per the Igea plant record; position 13 (built 2017) is biennial.
Evidence:
- Found by search: DLGSALLVII, Allegato VII, riga 15 | sentence: "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione antecedente 10 anni | Verifiche annuali" [DLGSALLVII, Allegato VII, riga 15]
- Found by search: DLGSALLVII, Allegato VII, riga 16 | sentence: "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg , non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione non antecedente 10 anni | Verifiche biennali" [DLGSALLVII, Allegato VII, riga 16]
- Found by search: igea-equipment, p. 6 | sentence: "GRU A PONTE 8 DEMAG 5000 CA 127 / 86 1985 503291 SCORREVOLE GRU A PONTE 9 DEMAG 5000 CA 128 / 86 1985 503292 SCORREVOLE GRU A PONTE 10 GUTTER 3000 CA 197 / 88 1988 24984 SCORREVOLE GRU A PONTE DEFRIES - 11 3000 CA 194 / 85 1978 11222 SCORREVOLE TITANO GRU A PONTE 12 PRIM 5000 NU 41/85 1980 160 SCORREVOLE" [igea-equipment, p. 6]
- Found by search: igea-equipment, p. 7 | sentence: "23 GRU A CAVALLETTO 35000 NU 16/95 1989 459 GCB 35 X 12/21 Classe: matr.459" [igea-equipment, p. 7]

response.text:
Allegato VII requires yearly verification for fixed equipment over 200 kg in the extractive sector built more than 10 years ago. Answer 2's evidence shows positions 8–12 built in 1985, 1985, 1988, 1978 and 1980, and the gantry crane at position 23 built in 1989, so all six qualify. Answer 1 leaves out positions 8–11, which the plant record does document.
